# Worth the Fee

> Straight answers on whether a travel card or programme is worth it for you. Each page answers one question, cites its sources and gives the date it was checked. Some pages end with a disclosed referral link.

## Questions

- [What are the Amex Platinum credits really worth if you only count the ones you would use anyway?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/amex-platinum-credits-real-value/): On paper the 11 main Amex Platinum credits total $2,994 a year. Your real number is only the ones you would have paid for anyway.
- [Does the Amex Platinum do anything for golfers?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/amex-platinum-for-golfers/): Very little directly. The US Amex Platinum has no free rounds, green fee credit or tee time perk, but its hotel credit and lounges can help a golf trip.
- [What does the Amex Platinum actually do for one Hawaii trip a year?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/amex-platinum-hawaii-trip/): One Hawaii trip gets up to $300 back on a prepaid hotel stay and lounge access in Honolulu and Maui. Kona and Lihue have no lounge the card opens.
- [Amex Platinum or Chase Sapphire Reserve for a once-a-year Hawaii trip?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/amex-platinum-vs-sapphire-reserve-hawaii/): For one Hawaii trip a year the Sapphire Reserve fits better: lower fee, a simple $300 travel credit and 1:1 Hyatt transfers.
- [Is the Amex Platinum worth its annual fee if you only fly 4 to 6 times a year?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/amex-platinum-worth-it-occasional-flyer/): Usually only if you would use about $900 of its credits anyway. At 4 to 6 flights a year, the lounges alone do not cover the $895 fee.
- [How do Amex referral offers work, and why does the page say "as high as" a number?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/amex-referral-offer-how-it-works/): An Amex referral link opens an application where Amex shows your own offer before you accept. "As high as" is the top figure, not a promise.
- [Is the Chase Sapphire Preferred worth it if you take one big trip a year?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/chase-sapphire-preferred-one-trip-a-year/): Usually yes: one hotel booking through Chase Travel returns $100 against the $95 fee, but only if you would book that way anyway.
- [How does the Rakuten sign-up bonus through a friend's link work, and what makes it fail?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/): Join through a friend's link, spend $50 on purchases that earn cash back within 90 days, and the bonus is paid on Rakuten's next payment date.
- [Can you get Amex points from Rakuten instead of cash, and is it worth switching?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/): Yes: Rakuten pays 1 Amex Membership Rewards point per cent of cash back. It is worth it only if you use points for more than 1 cent.
- [Sapphire Preferred or Sapphire Reserve for someone who travels two or three times a year?](https://dpwonder.github.io/worth-the-fee/sapphire-preferred-vs-reserve-light-traveler/): For two or three trips a year the $95 Preferred fits most people; the $795 Reserve pays off only if you use several of its credits.
